entries.en:
Well aware of the myriad challenges that await them, Grenoldt and Chora-Zoi are quick to resume discussions on the splendorous tools' improvement. Grenoldt asserts that this new creation requires a bold design to usher in a new age of trade for Norvrandt, yet it must retain the tools' well-loved adaptive properties. As ever, the Boutique is willing to part with extraordinary components from Qeshi-Trao's collection, but no rarity comes without its price, and you are tasked once again with the procurement of quality trade goods.

※Please note that you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: Your hard-earned goods serve as the catalyst for the newest splendorous tool─forged with shards from the Crystal Tower and wrapped with the selfsame iron utilized in the Crystarium's architecture. Chora-Zoi proudly urges you to take it in your hands, and as you hold your newest creation, you are filled with an overwhelming sense of pride. The tools will surely aid in Norvrandt's rebirth, and in crafting it, you have given the once-blighted world yet another reason to hope.
entries.fr: Chora-Zoi est parvenue à resculpter votre outil des merveilles, en y incorporant cette fois des fragments issus de la Tour de Cristal, une façon pour elle de rendre hommage aux artisans cristariens. Vous n'êtes désormais plus qu'à une étape du nec plus ultra tant espéré...

entries.en: I see you're as eager to get started as I am! The culmination of our hard work is finally at hand, and I'm ready to find out where our efforts will lead...not only for the future of Norvrandt, but for Master Grenoldt as well!
entries.fr: Bon allez, on se motive ! Pour la beauté de l'arrrt et pour l'avenir conjugal de maître Grenoldt, on va les parfaire, ces outils !
entries.ja:

entries.en: That's the way, lass! Now, afore we get to firin' up the forge, we'd best iron out our plans. The stakes are higher than the bleedin' Crystal Tower, an' it never hurts to be too thorough.
entries.fr: C'est le moment d'unir nos forces. Pour commencer, laissez-moi vous présenter l'idéal que je souhaite atteindre.
entries.ja:

まずは、吾の思う理想の道具を伝えよう。

entries.en: Our current tool should suffice as a base for the new model, an' that'll give us a right good foundation to work with. But it deserves a brand-new design─one what'll stir the hearts an' souls o' those who lay eyes upon it.
entries.fr: Nos outils des merveilles actuels ont beau être aboutis, ils conservent malgré tout leur aspect d'origine. Cette fois-ci, j'aimerais aller plus loin, et les remodeler entièrement ; leur offrir une apparence nouvelle et racée, à la hauteur de l'excellence qu'ils incarnent.
entries.ja:
現在のモーエンツールは、元の姿から至ったひとつの完成形……
ゆえに此度は古き型から、また新たな姿へと磨き上げたい。
真なる美しき姿を与えてこそ、至高の道具と呼べようものぞ。

entries.en: That said, we'll need to preserve the tool's adaptive properties as we improve upon the design. A new look won't mean bugger all without the functionality to match, so I suggest takin' a meticulous approach to ensure naught gets lost along the way.

entries.en: I've had a look at it myself, and I suspect it'll be a feast for the eyes when it's complete! I wanted to ensure the final product could serve as a proud symbol of the Crystarium, so I procured a few inspirational components of my own.
entries.fr: Je vous préviens, le prochain outil des merveilles s'annonce grandiose ! Au passage, j'ai dégoté un matériau supplémentairrre, qui devrait lui apporter une authentique touche cristarienne...
entries.ja:

クリスタリウムを象徴する道具となるよう、
私の方でも素材を集めてきました！

entries.en: The shards I have here are fallen fragments of the Crystal Tower─gathered with permission, of course! I'd heard that pieces of the tower were once used to craft the Crystal Exarch's staff, so I thought to incorporate them in our tool's design as well. Master Grenoldt was quite fond of the idea!
entries.fr: Tadaaa ! Alorrrs, pas mal, non ? Ce sont des fragments provenant de la Tour de Cristal, du même genre que les cristaux contenus dans le bâton de l'exarque. Enfin, à ce qu'il paraît !
entries.ja:
見てください、クリスタルタワーから剥離したクリスタル片！
水晶公がお持ちになっていた杖も、
こうしたクリスタル片から作られていたんですって……！

entries.en: Let's see... If I'm not mistaken, that should be everything we need to begin! The forging may take some time, but I promise you, it'll be well worth the wait!
entries.fr: J'ai l'outil et les matériaux ; il me reste plus qu'à employer tout mon talent et mon énergie pour façonner un chef-d'œuvrrre !

至高の姿を生み出すため……全力で取り組みますねっ！

entries.en: I must strike at the anvil with a precise rhythm... Master Grenoldt and Mistress Mowen's dance should serve as the ideal reference─every step part of an elegant flow, every motion made with flawless grace!
entries.fr: Mon marteau cogne en rythme tels des souliers sur la piste de danse... J'exécute chacun de mes gestes à la perrrfection, comme dans un ballet de sueur et de sang !

あの「だんす」の如く、すべての工程は流れるように美しく！
